name: scene-lock-acquire
title: Bridge / Scene Lock / Acquire
description: Acquire a project-level AIBridge scene lock for a multi-step scene E2E workflow. Hold this lock across scene builders, scene open/save, PlayMode tests, screenshots, and other scene-affecting bridge commands.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Logical owner label for the lock. Example: 'codex-map-e2e'.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Why this scene lock is needed. Example: 'MapSystem PlayMode + scene evidence capture'.

parameters.name: timeoutSeconds
parameters.description: How long to wait when mode='wait'. Default: 600.
